messages.author: ee7a1845b55c5f1d
messages.subject: Multiple heatmaps for circular tree
parts:
Dear ggtree group,

I wondered whether it is possible to plot a circular tree with multiple heatmaps with ggtree. Essentially I want one heatmap ring with a certain scale and a certain color, then a little space and then another heatmap ring with another color and another scale. I could not find any information on this and naively tried to just add another gheatmap with a different offset which didn't work.

Any thoughts on this would be greatly appreciated.

Cheers,
Martin

messages.author: cec41188340e8212
messages.subject: Re: Multiple heatmaps for circular tree
parts:
This is a limitation of ggplot2 and the data will be pooled with only one legend. It would be fine if you want a consistent color legend.

But if your data were measured in different ways or have different units, you definitely want to provide different color palettes. However this is not supported by ggplot2 directly. The most easy solution IMO is to use cowplot.

For re-ordering your data according to the tree structure, you can refer to the discussion on https://groups.google.com/forum/?utm_medium=email&utm_source=footer#!msg/bioc-ggtree/LqRDK78m3U4/hg5Cdf_ZAwAJ.
